a.xlink:title: Called periodically to send commands to the Nextion LCD display via USART.
Delays the current task for the specified number of milliseconds.
Updates current telemetry page by calling its handler if available.
Advances to the next selectable page.
Updates LCD display page.
Moves to the previous selectable page.
Sets the current page on the Nextion display.
Appends raw data to the buffer. If the data exceeds the buffer size, no data is appended.
Appends formatted data to the buffer using printf-style formatting. !
Build a coordinate from latitude and longitude already in degrees.
Configure GPIO EXTI lines from a configuration table.
Return the IRQ vector for pin: lines 0-4 are separate, 5-9 and 10-15 are shared.
Return the SYSCFG port selector for a supported GPIO bank (GPIOA-GPIOG).
Mask a line, route it, configure its trigger, clear stale pending state, and unmask it.
Enable the SYSCFG peripheral clock used for GPIO EXTI routing.
Sets the baud rate for the Nextion display.
Sets the brightness of the Nextion display.
Start a DMA-based transmission.
Check whether a transmission is still in progress.
Clears the buffer by resetting length to 0.
Reload the transfer count from handle->params.tx_size and start again.
Change the transfer length (element count) for the next transfer.
Disable the channel, stopping the transfer immediately.
Write a logic value to an output pin.
